roadmap.title: First Runs and Basic Unlocks
roadmap.description: Play short runs on Mad Forest, reach early levels, survive to the minute markers, and unlock the starting pickup passives and weapons.

roadmap.title: Weapon and Pickup Unlocks
roadmap.description: Unlock the remaining base weapons and passives by lighting sources, collecting pickups, holding six weapons, and killing enemies.

roadmap.title: Mad Forest Stage Goals
roadmap.description: Finish the Mad Forest checklist: reach level 20, defeat the Giant Blue Venus boss, grind Skeleton kills, and survive 20 minutes.

roadmap.title: Inlaid Library and Dairy Plant
roadmap.description: Move through the next stages: find the Stone Mask, reach the stage level gates, defeat the Hag and Sword Guardian, and open the Dairy Plant coffin.

roadmap.title: Weapon Evolutions
roadmap.description: During runs, hold each weapon and its partner passive at maximum level to evolve them and unlock the evolution weapons.

roadmap.title: Character and Progression Challenges
roadmap.description: Complete character-specific and lifetime goals: healing, coins, kills, Cursed runs, and long survival runs.

roadmap.title: Rerolls and Enemy Grinds
roadmap.description: Reach level 80 with the unlockable characters and farm the Lion Head enemies for their character unlock.

roadmap.title: Bonus Stages and Hypers
roadmap.description: Unlock Hyper mode on the main stages to open the bonus stages, then survive each bonus stage's time limit.

roadmap.title: Collection Progress
roadmap.description: Fill Collection entries to unlock the Mindbender feature.

roadmap.title: Coffins and Stage Characters
roadmap.description: Open the remaining stage coffins to unlock the characters hidden behind them. The Milky Way Map is required to see the coffin markers.

roadmap.title: Stage Bosses and Relics
roadmap.description: Clear the Gallo Tower and Cappella Magna checklists: defeat bosses, grind the stage enemies, and find their relics.

roadmap.title: Randomazzo and Minute 31
roadmap.description: Find the Randomazzo relic to enable Arcana, then survive past the minute 30 Death spawn in the main stages.

roadmap.title: Character Goals
roadmap.description: Reach level 50 with the listed characters and survive 15 minutes with the later unlockable ones to earn their Arcana and starting weapons.

roadmap.title: Weapon Evolutions
roadmap.description: Evolve or unite the advanced weapons during runs by maxing the weapon and its partner passive.

roadmap.title: Relics and Collection
roadmap.description: Collect the remaining stage relics and fill the Collection further to unlock more Banish upgrades.

roadmap.title: Hypers and Bonus Stages
roadmap.description: Unlock Hyper mode on more main stages to open The Bone Zone and Moongolow, then survive their time limits.

roadmap.title: Evolution Count and Rerolls
roadmap.description: Hold six evolutions at once, upgrade Torrona's Box, and reach level 80 with the remaining unlockable characters.

roadmap.title: Cappella Magna and Hyper Modes
roadmap.description: Clear the Cappella Magna, unlock Hyper mode on every normal stage, and survive the Boss Rash bonus stage.

roadmap.title: Arcana Characters
roadmap.description: Reach level 50 with the remaining base characters to unlock their Arcana cards.

roadmap.title: Secrets and Endgame Relics
roadmap.description: Find the Forbidden Scrolls, collect every relic, and finish the Eudaimonia M. stage for the final relics and ending.

roadmap.title: Collection and Evolution Mastery
roadmap.description: Complete the Collection, master evolutions and unions, and earn the later Seal upgrades.

roadmap.title: Inverse Stages
roadmap.description: Unlock Inverse mode and clear the Inverse Mad Forest and Gallo Tower checklists.

roadmap.title: Legacy of the Moonspell
roadmap.description: Work through the Mt.Moonspell DLC: its coffin, characters, weapon evolutions, boss, map, and enemy kills.

roadmap.title: Tides of the Foscari
roadmap.description: Work through the Lake Foscari and Abyss Foscari DLC stages, characters, weapon evolutions, seals, bosses, and enemy kills.

roadmap.title: Foscari Finale and Stage Maps
roadmap.description: Finish the Foscari DLC, reach the Astral Stair gate, and collect the stage maps of the newer stages.

roadmap.title: Whiteout and Laborratory
roadmap.description: Work through the Whiteout and Laborratory free-update stages, their weapons, relics, and time limits.

roadmap.title: Space 54 and Bat Country Grinds
roadmap.description: Work through Space 54, the Bat Country grind, and the weapons and characters tied to them.

roadmap.title: Coop and Adventures
roadmap.description: Clear The Coop stage, its relics and unlocks, and complete the Adventures with the later Seal upgrades.

roadmap.title: Darkasso Cards
roadmap.description: Unlock the Darkasso relic and complete the Darkasso card challenges that have achievements.

roadmap.title: Westwoods
roadmap.description: Work through the Westwoods stage, its relics, character, and Magi-Stone weapon line.

roadmap.title: Mazerella and Ammo
roadmap.description: Work through the Mazerella stage, the Ammo Appalate line, and the last Darkasso challenges.

achievements.summary: Reach level 5.

steps.text: Play any stage and collect experience gems until you reach level 5.

achievements.summary: Reach level 10.

steps.text: Keep collecting experience gems in any stage until you reach level 10.

achievements.summary: Survive 1 minute with any character.

steps.text: Start any stage and stay alive for 1 minute.

achievements.summary: Survive 5 minutes with Pasqualina.

steps.text: Start a run with Pasqualina and stay alive for 5 minutes.

achievements.summary: Survive 10 minutes with any character.

steps.text: Start any stage and stay alive for 10 minutes.

achievements.summary: Level the Fire Wand up to 4 during a run.

guide.context: The Fire Wand is unlocked by destroying 20 light sources.

steps.text: Pick up the Fire Wand during a run and keep choosing its upgrades until it reaches level 4.

achievements.summary: Get the King Bible to level 4.

steps.text: Pick up the King Bible during a run and keep choosing its upgrades until it reaches level 4.

achievements.summary: Get Santa Water to level 4.

steps.text: Pick up Santa Water during a run and keep choosing its upgrades until it reaches level 4.

achievements.summary: Level the Lightning Ring up to 4 during a run.

guide.context: The Lightning Ring is unlocked by defeating a total of 5000 enemies.

steps.text: Pick up the Lightning Ring during a run and keep choosing its upgrades until it reaches level 4.

achievements.summary: Get the Magic Wand to level 7.

steps.text: Pick up the Magic Wand during a run and keep choosing its upgrades until it reaches level 7.

achievements.summary: Get Peachone to level 7.

guide.context: Peachone is unlocked by surviving 10 minutes with any character.

steps.text: Pick up Peachone during a run and keep choosing its upgrades until it reaches level 7.

achievements.summary: Get the Runetracer to level 7.

guide.context: The Runetracer is unlocked by surviving 5 minutes with Pasqualina.

steps.text: Pick up the Runetracer during a run and keep choosing its upgrades until it reaches level 7.

achievements.summary: Hold 6 different weapons at the same time.

steps.text: During a run, keep choosing new weapons from the level-up choices until you are holding 6 different ones.

achievements.summary: Destroy 20 light sources.

guide.context: Light sources are the candles, braziers, and lamps standing around every stage. Breaking one can drop a pickup.

steps.text: Break candles, braziers, and lamps in any stage until you have destroyed 20.

achievements.summary: Find 5 Floor Chickens.

guide.context: Floor Chickens are the roast chicken healing pickups that lie on the ground in stages.

steps.text: Collect the roast chicken pickups you find until you have taken 5.

achievements.summary: Find a Little Clover.

guide.context: The Little Clover drops from light sources you destroy.

steps.text: Break light sources until a Little Clover appears, then pick it up.

achievements.summary: Find a Vacuum.

guide.context: The Vacuum drops from light sources you destroy.

steps.text: Break light sources until a Vacuum appears, then pick it up.

achievements.summary: Find an Orologion.

guide.context: An Orologion is the pocket-watch pickup that briefly freezes every enemy on screen.

steps.text: Collect an Orologion pickup when it appears in a stage.

achievements.summary: Find a Rosary.

guide.context: A Rosary is the cross-necklace pickup found in stages.

steps.text: Collect a Rosary pickup when it appears in a stage.

achievements.summary: Defeat a total of 5000 enemies.

guide.context: The kill total is kept across every run.

steps.text: Play stages normally and kill enemies until your lifetime total reaches 5000.

achievements.summary: Defeat a total of 3000 Skeletons.

guide.context: Only the Skeleton enemy counts; other skeleton-like enemies do not.

steps.text: Kill Skeletons in the Mad Forest and later stages until your lifetime Skeleton total reaches 3000.

achievements.summary: Survive 20 minutes with any character.

steps.text: Start any stage and stay alive for 20 minutes.

achievements.description: Defeat the giant Blue Venus in the Mad Forest.
achievements.summary: Kill the Giant Blue Venus boss in the Mad Forest.

guide.context: The Giant Blue Venus appears at minute 25, and only a kill in the Mad Forest counts.

steps.text: Reach minute 25 in the Mad Forest and defeat the Giant Blue Venus.

achievements.description: Defeat the Hag in the Inlaid Library.
achievements.summary: Kill the Hag boss in the Inlaid Library.

guide.context: The Hag appears at minute 25, and only a kill in the Inlaid Library counts.

steps.text: Reach minute 25 in the Inlaid Library and defeat the Hag.

achievements.description: Reach Level 20 in the Mad Forest.
achievements.summary: Reach level 20 in the Mad Forest.

steps.text: Start a run in the Mad Forest and collect experience gems until you reach level 20.

achievements.summary: Survive 5 minutes with Gennaro.

steps.text: Start a run with Gennaro and stay alive for 5 minutes.

achievements.summary: Find the Stone Mask in the Inlaid Library.

steps.text: Search the Inlaid Library and walk into the Stone Mask when you find it.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Whip into the Bloody Tear.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run. The evolved weapon then appears among the level-up choices.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Whip and the Hollow Heart passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Bloody Tear from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Magic Wand into the Holy Wand.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Magic Wand and the Empty Tome passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Holy Wand from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Knife into the Thousand Edge.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Knife and the Bracer passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Thousand Edge from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Axe into the Death Spiral.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Axe and the Candelabrador passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Death Spiral from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Cross into the Heaven Sword.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Cross and the Clover passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Heaven Sword from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Evolve the King Bible into the Unholy Vespers.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold the King Bible and the Spellbinder passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Unholy Vespers from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Fire Wand into the Hellfire.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Fire Wand and the Spinach passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Hellfire from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Get Garlic to level 7.

steps.text: Pick up Garlic during a run and keep choosing its upgrades until it reaches level 7.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Garlic into the Soul Eater.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Garlic and the Pummarola passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Soul Eater from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Unite Peachone and Ebony Wings.

guide.context: A union works like an evolution: both weapons must be at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold Peachone and Ebony Wings and level both to maximum.
Choose Vandalier from the level-up choices.

achievements.description: Unlock Hyper mode for 2 normal stages.
achievements.summary: Unlock Hyper mode on 2 normal stages.

guide.context: Defeating a normal stage's boss unlocks that stage's Hyper mode.

steps.text: Defeat the bosses of 2 different normal stages to unlock their Hyper modes.

achievements.summary: Restore a cumulative 1000 HP across runs.

guide.context: Healing from any source counts, and the total accumulates across runs.

steps.text: Collect Floor Chickens and use other healing sources across runs until the lifetime total reaches 1000.

achievements.description: Earn 5000 coins in a single run.
achievements.summary: Collect 5000 coins within one run.

guide.context: Only coins collected during one run count, and the tally resets between runs.

steps.text: Play a long run and collect gold from enemies, chests, and pickups until you earn 5000 before the run ends.

achievements.summary: Defeat a total of 100000 enemies.

guide.context: The total accumulates across all runs and rises on its own as you work on other goals.

steps.text: Keep playing stages and killing enemies until your lifetime total reaches 100000.

achievements.summary: Survive 20 minutes with Krochi.

steps.text: Start a run with Krochi and stay alive for 20 minutes.

achievements.summary: Evolve Santa Water into the La Borra.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold Santa Water and the Attractorb passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the La Borra from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Lightning Ring into the Thunder Loop.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Lightning Ring and the Duplicator passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Thunder Loop from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Reach level 80 with Mortaccio.

guide.context: Mortaccio is unlocked by defeating 3000 Skeletons.

steps.text: Start a run with Mortaccio and collect experience gems until you reach level 80.

achievements.summary: Survive 30 minutes in Green Acres.

guide.context: Green Acres is a bonus stage unlocked by unlocking Hyper mode for 2 normal stages.

steps.text: Enter Green Acres and stay alive until the 30-minute timer ends.

achievements.summary: Reach level 80 with Yatta Cavallo.

guide.context: Yatta Cavallo is unlocked by defeating 3000 Lion Heads.

steps.text: Start a run with Yatta Cavallo and collect experience gems until you reach level 80.

achievements.description: Defeat a total of 3000 Lion Heads.
achievements.summary: Kill a total of 3000 Lion Heads.

guide.context: Lion Heads spawn in the Inlaid Library at the minute marks 11, 18, 20, 21, and 22. The Colossal Lionhead boss does not count.

steps.text: Play Inlaid Library runs and kill Lion Heads until the lifetime total reaches 3000.

achievements.description: Survive 20 minutes with at least +10% Curse.
achievements.summary: Survive 20 minutes with any Curse bonus above its base value.

guide.context: The +10% in the in-game description is not required. Only the Curse bonus at the end of the run is checked, so any amount above the base value counts.

steps.text: Raise your Curse above its base value, start any stage, and stay alive for 20 minutes.

achievements.summary: Survive 30 minutes with Lama.

guide.context: Lama is unlocked by surviving 20 minutes with a Curse bonus active.

steps.text: Start a run with Lama and stay alive until the 30-minute timer ends.

achievements.description: Reach Level 40 in the Inlaid Library.
achievements.summary: Reach level 40 in the Inlaid Library.

steps.text: Start a run in the Inlaid Library and collect experience gems until you reach level 40.

achievements.description: Defeat the Sword Guardian in the Dairy Plant.
achievements.summary: Kill the Sword Guardian boss in the Dairy Plant.

guide.context: The Sword Guardian appears at minute 25, and only a kill in the Dairy Plant counts.

steps.text: Reach minute 25 in the Dairy Plant and defeat the Sword Guardian.

achievements.summary: Find the Milky Way Map in the Dairy Plant.

guide.context: The relic sits south of the stage start.

steps.text: Enter the Dairy Plant, walk south from the start, and collect the Milky Way Map.

achievements.description: Find and open the coffin in the Dairy Plant.
achievements.summary: Find the coffin in the Dairy Plant and open it.

guide.context: The coffin is marked as a question mark on the map once you have found the Milky Way Map, and the enemies guarding it must be defeated first.

steps.text: Find the Milky Way Map, then follow the question-mark marker in the Dairy Plant and defeat the enemies guarding the coffin.
Open the coffin.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with Poppea.

guide.context: Poppea is unlocked by opening the coffin in the Dairy Plant.

steps.text: Start a run with Poppea and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Song of Mana into the Mannajja.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Song of Mana and the Skull O'Maniac passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Mannajja from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Get Pentagram to level 7.

guide.context: The Pentagram is unlocked by surviving 20 minutes with any character.

steps.text: Pick up the Pentagram during a run and keep choosing its upgrades until it reaches level 7.

achievements.description: Unlock Hyper mode for any normal stage.
achievements.summary: Unlock Hyper mode for any normal stage.

guide.context: Defeating any one normal stage's boss unlocks that stage's Hyper mode, which opens the Il Molise bonus stage.

steps.text: Defeat the boss of any one normal stage to unlock its Hyper mode.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes in Molise.

guide.context: Molise is a bonus stage unlocked by unlocking Hyper mode for any normal stage.

steps.text: Enter Molise and stay alive until the 15-minute timer ends.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Pentagram into the Gorgeous Moon.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Pentagram and the Crown passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Gorgeous Moon from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Fill 50 entries in the Collection.

guide.context: The Collection grows as you obtain weapons, passives, and their evolutions, and entries persist across runs.

steps.text: Play runs and pick up weapons and passive items you have not obtained yet until the Collection shows 50 entries.

achievements.description: Find and open the coffin in the Mad Forest.
achievements.summary: Open the Mad Forest coffin.

guide.context: The coffin is marked as a question mark on the map once you have found the Milky Way Map, and its guardians must be defeated first.

steps.text: Find the Milky Way Map, then follow the question-mark marker in the Mad Forest and defeat the enemies guarding the coffin.
Open the coffin.

achievements.summary: Survive 10 minutes with Pugnala.

guide.context: Pugnala is unlocked by opening the coffin in the Mad Forest. This unlocks the Phiera Der Tuphello weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Pugnala and stay alive for 10 minutes.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with Pugnala.

guide.context: This unlocks the Eight The Sparrow weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Pugnala and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.description: Evolve and unite Phiera Der Tuphello and Eight The Sparrow.
achievements.summary: Combine Phiera Der Tuphello with Eight The Sparrow to make the Phieraggi.

guide.context: The union also needs the Tiragisú passive at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold Phiera Der Tuphello, Eight The Sparrow, and the Tiragisú passive and level all of them to maximum.
Choose the Phieraggi from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Runetracer into NO FUTURE.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Runetracer and the Armor passive and level both to maximum.
Choose NO FUTURE from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Reach level 80 with Bianca Ramba.

guide.context: Bianca Ramba is unlocked by killing 3000 Milk Elementals.

steps.text: Start a run with Bianca Ramba and collect experience gems until you reach level 80.

achievements.summary: Fill 60 entries in the Collection.

guide.context: Entries persist across runs, and the Collection fills as you obtain weapons and passives.

steps.text: Play runs and pick up weapons and passive items you have not obtained yet until the Collection shows 60 entries.

achievements.description: Defeat the Giant Enemy Crab in Gallo Tower.
achievements.summary: Kill the Giant Enemy Crab boss in the Gallo Tower.

guide.context: The Giant Enemy Crab appears at minute 25, and only a kill in the Gallo Tower counts.

steps.text: Reach minute 25 in the Gallo Tower and defeat the Giant Enemy Crab.

achievements.summary: Find the Sorceress' Tears relic in the Gallo Tower.

guide.context: The relic sits south of the stage start.

steps.text: Enter the Gallo Tower, walk south from the start, and collect the Sorceress' Tears.

achievements.description: Reach Level 60 in the Dairy Plant.
achievements.summary: Reach level 60 inside the Dairy Plant.

guide.context: This unlocks the Gallo Tower stage.

steps.text: Start a run in the Dairy Plant and collect experience gems until you reach level 60.

achievements.description: Defeat a total of 3000 Milk Elementals.
achievements.summary: Kill a total of 3000 Milk Elementals.

guide.context: Milk Elementals spawn in the Dairy Plant at minutes 1 to 6, 9, 10, and 11. The total is kept across runs.

steps.text: Play Dairy Plant runs and kill Milk Elementals until the lifetime total reaches 3000.

achievements.summary: Fill 70 entries in the Collection.

guide.context: Entries persist across runs, and the Collection fills as you obtain weapons and passives.

steps.text: Play runs and pick up weapons and passive items you have not obtained yet until the Collection shows 70 entries.

achievements.summary: Find the Randomazzo in the Gallo Tower.

guide.context: It sits north of the stage start and unlocks the Arcana system.

steps.text: Enter the Gallo Tower, walk north from the start, and collect the Randomazzo.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with Giovanna.

guide.context: Giovanna is unlocked by opening the coffin in the Inlaid Library. This unlocks the Gatti Amari weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Giovanna and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.description: Find and open the coffin in the Inlaid Library.
achievements.summary: Open the Inlaid Library coffin.

guide.context: The coffin is marked as a question mark on the map once you have found the Milky Way Map, and its guardians must be defeated first.

steps.text: Find the Milky Way Map, then follow the question-mark marker in the Inlaid Library and defeat the enemies guarding the coffin.
Open the coffin.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with Giovanna.

guide.context: Requires the Randomazzo relic, and awards the V - Chaos in the Dark Night Arcana.

steps.text: Start a run with Giovanna and collect experience gems until you reach level 50.

steps.text: Start a run with Krochi and collect experience gems until you reach level 50.

guide.context: Finding the relic awards the VI - Sarabande of Healing Arcana.

steps.text: Enter the Gallo Tower, walk north from the start, and collect the Randomazzo.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with Lama.

guide.context: Requires the Randomazzo relic, and awards the XVI - Slash Arcana.

steps.text: Start a run with Lama and collect experience gems until you reach level 50.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with Poppea.

guide.context: Requires the Randomazzo relic, and awards the XVII - Lost and Found Painting Arcana.

steps.text: Start a run with Poppea and collect experience gems until you reach level 50.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with Arca.

guide.context: Requires the Randomazzo relic, and awards the XIX - Heart of Fire Arcana.

achievements.summary: Kill a total of 3000 Dragon Shrimps.

achievements.description: Unlock Hyper mode for 3 normal stages.
achievements.summary: Unlock Hyper mode on 3 normal stages.

achievements.summary: Survive 30 minutes inside The Bone Zone.

achievements.summary: Reach level 80 with O'Sole Meeo.

guide.context: O'Sole Meeo is unlocked by killing 3000 Dragon Shrimps.

steps.text: Start a run with O'Sole Meeo and collect experience gems until you reach level 80.

steps.text: Start a run with Imelda and collect experience gems until you reach level 50.

Choose the Vicious Hunger from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Shadow Pinion into the Valkyrie Turner.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon and its partner passive both at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Shadow Pinion and the Wings passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Valkyrie Turner from the level-up choices.

achievements.description: Reach minute 31 in the Inlaid Library.
achievements.summary: Survive to minute 31 in the Inlaid Library.

guide.context: The Randomazzo relic must be found first, and Death spawns at minute 30 and kills in one hit unless it is frozen and blocked.

steps.text: Unlock the Clock Lancet and the Laurel passive.
Start a run in the Inlaid Library with both items and level them to maximum.
Keep Death frozen with the Clock Lancet and let the Laurel absorb its hit while you reach minute 31.

achievements.summary: Fill 80 entries in the Collection.

guide.context: Entries persist across runs, and the Collection fills as you obtain weapons and passives.

steps.text: Play runs and pick up weapons and passive items you have not obtained yet until the Collection shows 80 entries.

achievements.summary: Find the Magic Banger relic in Green Acres.

guide.context: It lies to the south-east of the stage start.

steps.text: Enter Green Acres, walk to the south-east of the start, and collect the Magic Banger.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with Concetta.

guide.context: Concetta is unlocked by opening the coffin in the Gallo Tower. This unlocks the Shadow Pinion weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Concetta and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.description: Unlock Hyper mode for 4 normal stages.
achievements.summary: Unlock Hyper mode on 4 normal stages.

guide.context: Defeating a normal stage's boss unlocks that stage's Hyper mode.

steps.text: Defeat the bosses of 4 different normal stages to unlock their Hyper modes.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes in Moongolow.

guide.context: Moongolow is a bonus stage unlocked by unlocking Hyper mode for 4 normal stages.

steps.text: Enter Moongolow and stay alive until the 15-minute timer ends.

achievements.description: Find and buy the Glass Vizard.
achievements.summary: Find and buy the Glass Vizard from the merchant in Moongolow.

steps.text: Reach Moongolow, find the merchant, and buy the Glass Vizard.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with Pasqualina.

guide.context: Requires the Randomazzo relic, and awards the XIV - Jail of Crystal Arcana.

steps.text: Start a run with Pasqualina and collect experience gems until you reach level 50.

achievements.description: Reach minute 31 in the Gallo Tower.
achievements.summary: Survive to minute 31 in the Gallo Tower.

guide.context: The Randomazzo relic must be found first, and Death spawns at minute 30 and kills in one hit unless it is frozen and blocked.

steps.text: Unlock the Clock Lancet and the Laurel passive.
Start a run in the Gallo Tower with both items and level them to maximum.
Keep Death frozen with the Clock Lancet and let the Laurel absorb its hit while you reach minute 31.

achievements.summary: Fill 90 entries in the Collection.

guide.context: Entries persist across runs, and the Collection fills as you obtain weapons and passives.

steps.text: Play runs and pick up weapons and passive items you have not obtained yet until the Collection shows 90 entries.

achievements.summary: Find the Yellow Sign.

guide.context: In the Moongolow bonus stage, a standard character must survive to minute 14 and defeat the stage boss to reach the Holy Forbidden.

steps.text: Play Moongolow with a standard character and survive to minute 14.
Defeat the stage boss to be taken to the Holy Forbidden.
Run through the Holy Forbidden to its end and collect the Yellow Sign.

achievements.summary: Obtain the Infinite Corridor.

guide.context: It is the evolution of the Clock Lancet combined with the Gold Ring and the Silver Ring, and the rings only appear after the Yellow Sign is found.

steps.text: Find the Yellow Sign first.
In one run, hold the Clock Lancet, the Gold Ring, and the Silver Ring and level them to maximum.
Choose the Infinite Corridor from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Obtain the Crimson Shroud.

guide.context: It is the evolution of the Laurel combined with Metaglio Left and Metaglio Right, and those pieces only appear after the Yellow Sign is found.

steps.text: Find the Yellow Sign first.
In one run, hold the Laurel, Metaglio Left, and Metaglio Right and level them to maximum.
Choose the Crimson Shroud from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with Antonio.

guide.context: Requires the Randomazzo relic, and awards the X - Beginning Arcana.

steps.text: Start a run with Antonio and collect experience gems until you reach level 50.

achievements.description: Reach minute 31 in the Mad Forest.
achievements.summary: Survive to minute 31 in the Mad Forest.

guide.context: The Randomazzo relic must be found first, and Death spawns at minute 30 and kills in one hit unless it is frozen and blocked.

steps.text: Unlock the Clock Lancet and the Laurel passive.
Start a run in the Mad Forest with both items and level them to maximum.
Keep Death frozen with the Clock Lancet and let the Laurel absorb its hit while you reach minute 31.

achievements.description: Hold 6 different weapon evolutions at once.
achievements.summary: Hold 6 different weapon evolutions during one run.

guide.context: Evolutions are the upgraded weapons produced when a maxed weapon is paired with its partner passive.

steps.text: In one run, build and hold 6 different evolved weapons at the same time.

achievements.summary: Get Torrona's Box to level 9.

guide.context: Torrona's Box is unlocked by holding 6 weapon evolutions at once.

steps.text: Pick up Torrona's Box and keep choosing its upgrades until it reaches level 9.

achievements.description: Reach Level 80 in the Gallo Tower.
achievements.summary: Reach level 80 while in the Gallo Tower.

guide.context: This unlocks the Cappella Magna stage.

steps.text: Start a run in the Gallo Tower and collect experience gems until you reach level 80.

achievements.description: Find and open the coffin in the Cappella Magna.
achievements.summary: Open the Cappella Magna coffin.

guide.context: The coffin is marked as a question mark on the map once you have found the Milky Way Map, and its guardians must be defeated first.

steps.text: Find the Milky Way Map, then follow the question-mark marker in the Cappella Magna and defeat the enemies guarding the coffin.
Open the coffin.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with Zi'Assunta.

guide.context: Zi'Assunta is unlocked by opening the coffin in the Cappella Magna. This unlocks the Vento Sacro weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Zi'Assunta and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.description: Unite Vento Sacro and Bloody Tear.
achievements.summary: Unite Vento Sacro and the Bloody Tear into the Fuwalafuwaloo.

guide.context: The Bloody Tear is itself the evolved Whip, and both weapons must be at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: In one run, evolve the Whip into the Bloody Tear, then hold Vento Sacro as well and level both to maximum.
Choose the Fuwalafuwaloo from the level-up choices.

achievements.description: Defeat the Trinacria in the Cappella Magna.
achievements.summary: Kill the Trinacria boss in the Cappella Magna.

guide.context: The Trinacria appears at minute 25, and only a kill in the Cappella Magna counts.

steps.text: Reach minute 25 in the Cappella Magna and defeat the Trinacria.

achievements.description: Defeat a total of 6000 Stage Killers.
achievements.summary: Kill a total of 6000 Stage Killers.

guide.context: Stage Killers spawn in the Cappella Magna at minutes 21 and 26. Only Stage Killers and Elite Stage Killers count, and the total is kept across runs.

steps.text: Play Cappella Magna runs and kill Stage Killers until the lifetime total reaches 6000.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with Porta.

guide.context: Requires the Randomazzo relic, and awards the III - Tragic Princess Arcana.

steps.text: Start a run with Porta and collect experience gems until you reach level 50.

achievements.description: Reach minute 31 in the Dairy Plant.
achievements.summary: Survive to minute 31 in the Dairy Plant.

guide.context: The Randomazzo relic must be found first, and Death spawns at minute 30 and kills in one hit unless it is frozen and blocked.

steps.text: Unlock the Clock Lancet and the Laurel passive.
Start a run in the Dairy Plant with both items and level them to maximum.
Keep Death frozen with the Clock Lancet and let the Laurel absorb its hit while you reach minute 31.

achievements.summary: Fill 100 entries in the Collection.

guide.context: Entries persist across runs, and the Collection fills as you obtain weapons and passives.

steps.text: Play runs and pick up weapons and passive items you have not obtained yet until the Collection shows 100 entries.

achievements.summary: Reach level 80 with Sir Ambrojoe.

guide.context: Sir Ambrojoe is unlocked by killing 6000 Stage Killers.

steps.text: Start a run with Sir Ambrojoe and collect experience gems until you reach level 80.

achievements.summary: Find the Grim Grimoire relic in the Inlaid Library.

guide.context: It sits to the far west of the stage start.

steps.text: Enter the Inlaid Library, walk west from the start, and collect the Grim Grimoire.

achievements.summary: Find the Ars Gouda relic in the Dairy Plant.

guide.context: It sits south of the stage start.

steps.text: Enter the Dairy Plant, walk south from the start, and collect the Ars Gouda.

achievements.summary: Find the Great Gospel relic in the Cappella Magna.

guide.context: It appears once the stage's final enemy has been defeated.

steps.text: Clear the Cappella Magna, defeat the final enemy, and collect the Great Gospel that appears.

achievements.description: Defeat the final enemy in the Cappella Magna.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Cappella Magna's final enemy.

guide.context: This awards the Game Killer Arcana.

steps.text: Reach the final enemy in a Cappella Magna run and defeat it.

achievements.description: Unlock Hyper mode for all 5 normal stages.
achievements.summary: Unlock Hyper mode on all 5 normal stages.

guide.context: Defeating a normal stage's boss unlocks that stage's Hyper mode.

steps.text: Defeat the bosses of all 5 normal stages to unlock their Hyper modes.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes in Boss Rash.

guide.context: Boss Rash is a bonus stage that opens once Hyper mode is unlocked on all 5 normal stages.

steps.text: Enter Boss Rash and stay alive until the 15-minute timer ends.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with Dommario.

guide.context: Requires the Randomazzo relic, and awards the II - Twilight Requiem Arcana.

steps.text: Start a run with Dommario and collect experience gems until you reach level 50.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with Pugnala.

guide.context: Requires the Randomazzo relic, and awards the I - Gemini Arcana.

steps.text: Start a run with Pugnala and collect experience gems until you reach level 50.

achievements.description: Find the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane.
achievements.summary: Find the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane.

guide.context: In The Bone Zone, a giant skeleton ball patrols the south-east. Defeat it and collect the relic it leaves behind.

steps.text: Unlock The Bone Zone, find the giant skeleton ball in the south-east, defeat it, and collect the relic.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with Christine.

guide.context: Requires the Randomazzo relic, and awards the XIII - Wicked Season Arcana.

steps.text: Start a run with Christine and collect experience gems until you reach level 50.

achievements.summary: Complete the Collection 1.0.

guide.context: The Victory Sword and the Sole Solution are not required.

steps.text: Obtain every other weapon and passive item listed in the Collection.

achievements.description: Defeat 100000 enemies in a single run with Queen Sigma.
achievements.summary: Kill 100000 enemies in one run with Queen Sigma.

guide.context: Endless mode makes the single-run total much easier to reach.

steps.text: Start a run with Queen Sigma and kill enemies until the run total reaches 100000.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with Suor Clerici.

guide.context: Requires the Randomazzo relic, and awards the IX - Divine Bloodline Arcana.

steps.text: Start a run with Suor Clerici and collect experience gems until you reach level 50.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 with Poe.

guide.context: Requires the Randomazzo relic, and awards the XXI - Blood Astronomia Arcana.

steps.text: Start a run with Poe and collect experience gems until you reach level 50.

achievements.description: Survive 30 minutes with either Gallo or Divano.
achievements.summary: Finish a 30-minute run as Gallo or Divano.

guide.context: Gallo is unlocked by the Infinite Corridor and Divano by the Crimson Shroud.

steps.text: Start a run with Gallo or Divano and stay alive until the timer completes.

achievements.description: Evolve the Bracelet and then the Bi-Bracelet.
achievements.summary: Evolve the Bracelet into the Bi-Bracelet, then into the Tri-Bracelet.

guide.context: An evolution needs the weapon at maximum level in the current run.

steps.text: Start a run with the Bracelet and level it to maximum.
Choose the Bi-Bracelet, max it out, then choose the Tri-Bracelet.

achievements.description: Discover every standard evolution and union.
achievements.summary: Discover every standard evolution and union.

guide.context: Only the base-game evolutions and unions count.

steps.text: Create each base-game evolution and union at least once across your runs.

achievements.description: Obtain all standard relics from all stages.
achievements.summary: Collect every standard relic from the main stages.

guide.context: Completing the set unlocks the Eudaimonia M. stage.

steps.text: Find each relic in each main stage; the green arrow on screen points to the current one.

achievements.summary: Obtain Gracia's Mirror.

guide.context: Unlocks Inverse mode.

steps.text: Enter the Eudaimonia M. stage and confirm the [OK] prompt repeatedly.
When the choice appears, pick the Too Easy option.

achievements.summary: Obtain the Seventh Trumpet.

guide.context: Unlocks Endless mode and requires Gracia's Mirror first.

steps.text: Obtain Gracia's Mirror, then open any stage with the Reverse option and exit to the main menu.
Return to Eudaimonia M., confirm the [OK] prompt, and pick the Too Hard option.

achievements.summary: See the final fireworks.

guide.context: Reached from the Eudaimonia M. stage after both relics are obtained.

steps.text: Obtain the Seventh Trumpet, then open any stage with Endless mode active and exit to the main menu.
Return to Eudaimonia M.
Defeat the final boss that appears and watch the credits to the end.

achievements.description: Banish 10 or more weapons in a single run.
achievements.summary: Banish at least 10 weapons during one run.

guide.context: Passive items also count toward the total, and the Banish upgrades must be unlocked from the Collection first.

steps.text: In one run, use the Banish option at least 10 times on weapons or passives.

achievements.description: Reach Level 80 in Inverse Gallo Tower.
achievements.summary: Reach level 80 on Inverse Gallo Tower.

guide.context: Inverse mode is unlocked by obtaining Gracia's Mirror.

steps.text: Start a run on Inverse Gallo Tower and collect experience gems until you reach level 80.

achievements.description: Find and open the coffin in Mt.Moonspell.
achievements.summary: Open the Mt.Moonspell coffin.

guide.context: The coffin is marked as a question mark on the map once the Milky Way Map is found, and its guardians must be defeated first.

steps.text: Find the Milky Way Map, then follow the question-mark marker in Mt.Moonspell and defeat the enemies guarding the coffin.
Open the coffin.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with Miang Moonspell.

guide.context: Unlocks the Silver Wind weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Miang Moonspell and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Silver Wind into the Festive Winds.

guide.context: The Silver Wind evolves with the Pummarola passive at maximum level.

steps.text: Start a run with Miang and hold the Silver Wind and the Pummarola passive.
Level both to maximum and choose the Festive Winds.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with Menya Moonspell.

guide.context: Unlocks the Four Seasons weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Menya Moonspell and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Four Seasons into the Godai Shuffle.

guide.context: The Four Seasons evolves with the Spinach and Candelabrador passives at maximum level.

steps.text: Start a run with Menya and hold the Four Seasons, Spinach, and Candelabrador.
Level all three to maximum and choose the Godai Shuffle.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with Syuuto Moonspell.

guide.context: Unlocks the Summon Night weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Syuuto Moonspell and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Summon Night into the Echo Night.

guide.context: The Summon Night evolves with the Duplicator passive at maximum level.

steps.text: Start a run with Syuuto and hold the Summon Night and the Duplicator passive.
Level both to maximum and choose the Echo Night.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with Babi-Onna.

guide.context: Unlocks the Mirage Robe weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Babi-Onna and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Mirage Robe into the J'Odore.

guide.context: The Mirage Robe evolves with the Attractorb passive at maximum level.

steps.text: Start a run with Babi-Onna and hold the Mirage Robe and the Attractorb passive.
Level both to maximum and choose the J'Odore.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with McCoy-Oni.

guide.context: Unlocks the 108 Bocce weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with McCoy-Oni and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.description: Defeat 100000 enemies in a single run with Menya Moonspell.
achievements.summary: Kill 100000 enemies in one run with Menya Moonspell.

guide.context: Endless mode makes the single-run total much easier to reach.

steps.text: Start a run with Menya Moonspell and kill enemies until the run total reaches 100000.

achievements.description: Defeat 100000 enemies in a single run with Syuuto Moonspell.
achievements.summary: Kill 100000 enemies in one run with Syuuto Moonspell.

guide.context: Endless mode makes the single-run total much easier to reach.

steps.text: Start a run with Syuuto Moonspell and kill enemies until the run total reaches 100000.

achievements.summary: Kill a total of 6000 Kappa.

guide.context: Kappa spawn around the frozen lake and the southern river of Mt.Moonspell instead of on a timer, and staying at the centre of the frozen lake stops other enemies spawning. The total is kept across runs.

steps.text: Play Mt.Moonspell runs and kill Kappa until the lifetime total reaches 6000.

achievements.summary: Find the Night Sword in Mt.Moonspell.

guide.context: It sits at the highest accessible point of the stage.

steps.text: Climb Mt.Moonspell to its highest point and collect the Night Sword.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Night Sword into the Muramasa.

guide.context: The Night Sword evolves with the Stone Mask passive at maximum level.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Night Sword and the Stone Mask passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Muramasa from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Kill the Orochimario boss in Mt.Moonspell.

guide.context: The Orochimario appears at minute 25, right where you are standing.

steps.text: Reach minute 25 in Mt.Moonspell and defeat the Orochimario.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Mille Bolle Blu into the Boo Roo Boolle.

guide.context: The Mille Bolle Blu evolves with the Spellbinder passive at maximum level.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Mille Bolle Blu and the Spellbinder passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Boo Roo Boolle from the level-up choices.

achievements.description: Reach Level 80 in Inverse Mad Forest.
achievements.summary: Reach level 80 on Inverse Mad Forest.

guide.context: This unlocks the Bat Country stage.

steps.text: Start a run on Inverse Mad Forest and collect experience gems until you reach level 80.

achievements.description: Find the Apoplexy at minute 09:00 in Bat Country.
achievements.summary: Collect the Apoplexy in Bat Country at the 9:00 mark.

steps.text: Play Bat Country and pick up the Apoplexy when it appears at minute 9:00.

achievements.description: Find the Chaos Malachite at minute 18:00 in Bat Country.
achievements.summary: Collect the Chaos Malachite in Bat Country at the 18:00 mark.

steps.text: Play Bat Country and pick up the Chaos Malachite when it appears at minute 18:00.

achievements.description: Banish 20 or more weapons in a single run.
achievements.summary: Banish at least 20 weapons during one run.

guide.context: Passive items also count toward the total.

steps.text: In one run, use the Banish option at least 20 times on weapons or passives.

achievements.description: Find and open the coffin in Lake Foscari.
achievements.summary: Open the Lake Foscari coffin.

guide.context: The coffin is marked as a question mark on the map once the Milky Way Map is found, and its guardians must be defeated first.

steps.text: Find the Milky Way Map, then follow the question-mark marker in Lake Foscari and defeat the enemies guarding the coffin.
Open the coffin.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with Eleanor Uziron.

guide.context: Unlocks the SpellString weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Eleanor Uziron and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.summary: Get SpellStream to level 6.

guide.context: Eleanor receives SpellStream at character level 10.

steps.text: Start a run with Eleanor, reach character level 10 to obtain SpellStream, then level it to 6.

achievements.summary: Get SpellStrike to level 6.

guide.context: Eleanor receives SpellStrike at character level 20.

steps.text: Start a run with Eleanor, reach character level 20 to obtain SpellStrike, then level it to 6.

achievements.summary: Unite SpellString, SpellStream, and SpellStrike.

guide.context: All three spells must be at maximum level in the same run.

steps.text: With Eleanor, obtain SpellString, SpellStream, and SpellStrike and level all three to maximum.
Choose Maruto Cuts from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with Maruto Cuts.

guide.context: Unlocks the Eskizzibur weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Maruto Cuts and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Eskizzibur into the Keitha Muort.

guide.context: The Eskizzibur evolves with the Armor passive at maximum level.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Eskizzibur and the Armor passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Keitha Muort from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with Keitha Muort.

guide.context: Unlocks the Flash Arrow weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Keitha Muort and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Flash Arrow into the Millionaire.

steps.text: Max out the Flash Arrow during a run with Keitha and choose the Millionaire from the level-up choices.

achievements.description: With Keitha, break the Seal of the Lake.
achievements.summary: Break the Seal of the Lake with Keitha.

guide.context: A crystal floats on the peninsula in the lake at the top-right of Lake Foscari. Restart the game if the achievement does not register.

steps.text: Start a Lake Foscari run with Keitha and level her starting weapon to maximum.
Travel to the top-right peninsula in the lake and destroy the crystal.

achievements.description: With Maruto, break the Seal of the Abyss.
achievements.summary: Break the Seal of the Abyss with Maruto.

guide.context: In Abyss Foscari, the crystal sits at the map's question mark. Restart the game if the achievement does not register.

steps.text: Start an Abyss Foscari run with Maruto and level his starting weapon to maximum.
Open the map, travel to the question mark, and destroy the crystal.

achievements.description: With Eleanor, break the Seal of the Banished.
achievements.summary: Break the Seal of the Banished with Eleanor.

guide.context: In Abyss Foscari, the crystal sits at the map's question mark and breaking it triggers the DLC final boss. Restart the game if the achievement does not register.

steps.text: Start an Abyss Foscari run with Eleanor and level her starting weapon to maximum.
Open the map, travel to the question mark, and destroy the crystal.

achievements.summary: Survive 15 minutes with Luminaire Foscari.

guide.context: Unlocks the Prismatic Missile weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Luminaire Foscari and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Prismatic Missile into the Luminaire.

steps.text: Max out the Prismatic Missile during a run and choose the Luminaire from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Stay alive for 15 minutes as Genevieve Gruyère.

guide.context: Unlocks the Shadow Servant weapon.

steps.text: Start a run with Genevieve Gruyère and stay alive for 15 minutes.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Shadow Servant into the Ophion.

steps.text: Max out the Shadow Servant during a run and choose the Ophion from the level-up choices.

achievements.description: Defeat 100000 enemies in a single run with Genevieve Gruyère.
achievements.summary: Kill 100000 enemies in one run with Genevieve Gruyère.

guide.context: Endless mode makes the single-run total much easier to reach.

steps.text: Start a run with Genevieve Gruyère and kill enemies until the run total reaches 100000.

achievements.summary: Kill a total of 6000 Sammies.

guide.context: Sammies appear in the Lake Foscari stage, and the total is kept across runs.

steps.text: Play Lake Foscari runs and kill Sammies until the lifetime total reaches 6000.

achievements.description: Defeat a total of 6000 Rotting Ghouls.
achievements.summary: Kill a total of 6000 Rotting Ghouls.

guide.context: Rotting Ghouls appear throughout Abyss Foscari, and the total is kept across runs.

steps.text: Play Abyss Foscari runs and kill Rotting Ghouls until the lifetime total reaches 6000.

achievements.description: Defeat the Avatar of Gaea in Lake Foscari.
achievements.summary: Kill the Avatar of Gaea boss in Lake Foscari.

guide.context: The boss spawns at minute 25.

steps.text: Reach minute 25 in Lake Foscari and defeat the Avatar of Gaea.

achievements.summary: Kill Je-Ne-Viv in Abyss Foscari.

guide.context: Breaking the third seal triggers the DLC final boss fight.

steps.text: In Abyss Foscari, break the seal with Eleanor to start the final fight.
Defeat Je-Ne-Viv.

achievements.description: Reach Level 80 in Inverse Inlaid Library.
achievements.summary: Reach level 80 on Inverse Inlaid Library.

guide.context: This unlocks the Astral Stair stage.

steps.text: Start a run on Inverse Inlaid Library and collect experience gems until you reach level 80.

achievements.description: Find the Chaos Rosalia in Astral Stair.
achievements.summary: Find the Chaos Rosalia during an Astral Stair run.

guide.context: Unlocks the Yatta Daikarin.

steps.text: Search Astral Stair and collect the Chaos Rosalia.

achievements.description: Find the Trisection in Astral Stair.
achievements.summary: Find the Trisection in Astral Stair.

guide.context: Unlocks Random Events.

steps.text: Search Astral Stair and collect the Trisection.

achievements.summary: Find the Astral Stair Map.

guide.context: The map is found in the Astral Stair stage.

steps.text: Reach Astral Stair and collect the Astral Stair Map.

achievements.summary: Find the Mt.Moonspell Map.

guide.context: It is found in the Mt.Moonspell stage.

steps.text: Enter Mt.Moonspell and collect the Mt.Moonspell Map.

achievements.summary: Find the Lake Foscari Map.

guide.context: It is found in the Lake Foscari stage.

steps.text: Enter Lake Foscari and collect the Lake Foscari Map.

achievements.description: Find the Chaos Altemanna in Tiny Bridge.
achievements.summary: Find the Chaos Altemanna during a Tiny Bridge run.

guide.context: Unlocks Profusione D'Amore.

steps.text: Enter Tiny Bridge and collect the Chaos Altemanna.

achievements.summary: Find 20 Orologions in total.

guide.context: Unlocks the Whiteout stage, and collections from earlier runs count.

steps.text: Collect Orologion pickups across your runs until the lifetime total reaches 20.

achievements.summary: Get the Glass Fandango to level 7.

guide.context: The Glass Fandango is found in the Whiteout stage.

steps.text: Pick up the Glass Fandango in Whiteout and keep choosing its upgrades until it reaches level 7.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Glass Fandango into the Celestial Voulge.

guide.context: The Glass Fandango evolves with the Wings passive at maximum level.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Glass Fandango and the Wings passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Celestial Voulge from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Survive 20 minutes in Whiteout.

guide.context: Unlocks the She-Moon Eeta character.

steps.text: Enter Whiteout and stay alive for 20 minutes.

achievements.summary: Find the Antidote in Whiteout.

guide.context: Unlocks the Defang PowerUp.

steps.text: Follow the green arrow in Whiteout and collect the Antidote.

achievements.description: Obtain the Atlas Gate in Boss Rash.
achievements.summary: Collect the Atlas Gate in Boss Rash.

guide.context: Unlocks the base-game Adventures.

steps.text: Survive in Boss Rash until the Atlas Gate spawns and collect it.

achievements.summary: Find 5 Golden Fingers.

guide.context: Golden Fingers always sit in the centre of Astral Stair's side rooms and unlock Space 54.

steps.text: Open the side rooms of Astral Stair and collect the Golden Finger at the centre of each until you have 5.

achievements.summary: Get the Phas3r to level 7.

guide.context: The Phas3r is obtained in Space 54.

steps.text: Pick up the Phas3r in Space 54 and keep choosing its upgrades until it reaches level 7.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Phas3r into the Photonstorm.

guide.context: In Space 54, upgrade the Phas3r with the Empty Tome and Hollow Heart passives.

steps.text: In one run in Space 54, hold the Phas3r, the Empty Tome, and the Hollow Heart and level them to maximum.
Choose the Photonstorm from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Survive 20 minutes in Space 54.

guide.context: Unlocks the Space Dude character.

steps.text: Enter Space 54 and stay alive for 20 minutes.

achievements.description: Find the Brave Story at minute 18 in Space 54.
achievements.summary: Collect the Brave Story in Space 54 at minute 18.

guide.context: Unlocks Random LevelUp.

steps.text: Play Space 54 and pick up the Brave Story when it spawns at minute 18.

achievements.summary: Kill a total of 161616 bats.

guide.context: Kills made before the update count, but the achievement registers only after you exit a stage.

steps.text: Kill bats across your runs until the lifetime total reaches 161616.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Pako Battiliar into the Bat Robbert.

guide.context: In Space 54, upgrade the Pako Battiliar with the Empty Tome and Hollow Heart passives.

steps.text: In one run in Space 54, hold the Pako Battiliar, the Empty Tome, and the Hollow Heart and level them to maximum.
Choose the Bat Robbert from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Find 33 Rosaries in total.

guide.context: Unlocks the Laborratory stage, and collections from earlier runs count.

steps.text: Collect Rosary pickups across your runs until the lifetime total reaches 33.

achievements.summary: Get the Santa Javelin to level 7.

guide.context: The Santa Javelin comes from the lever rooms in Laborratory.

steps.text: Open the lever rooms in Laborratory until you obtain the Santa Javelin, then level it to 7.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Santa Javelin into the Seraphic Cry.

guide.context: The Santa Javelin evolves with the Clover passive.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Santa Javelin and the Clover passive and level both to maximum.
Choose the Seraphic Cry from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Survive 20 minutes in Laborratory.

guide.context: Unlocks the Santa Ladonna character.

steps.text: Enter Laborratory and stay alive for 20 minutes.

achievements.summary: Find an Arma Dio.

guide.context: The Arma Dio comes from the lever rooms in Laborratory.

steps.text: Keep activating the levers in the Laborratory rooms until the Arma Dio appears and collect it.

achievements.description: Deal a total of 25120 damage with the Laborratory Train.
achievements.summary: Deal 25120 damage with the Laborratory Train.

guide.context: The train is activated with the levers along the tracks at the bottom of the stage.

steps.text: Activate the train with the levers at the bottom of Laborratory.
Let the train damage enemies until the total reaches 25120.

achievements.description: Banish 40 or more weapons in a single run.
achievements.summary: Banish at least 40 weapons during one run.

guide.context: Passive items also count toward the total.

steps.text: In one run, use the Banish option at least 40 times on weapons or passives.

achievements.description: Complete once the adventure A Garlic Paradise.
achievements.summary: Complete the adventure A Garlic Paradise.

guide.context: Adventures are opened from the main menu and their challenges are listed on the Progress screen.

steps.text: Open the A Garlic Paradise adventure and finish every objective it lists.

achievements.displayName: EXTRA: World of Light and Dark
achievements.description: Complete once the adventure World of Light and Dark.
achievements.summary: Finish World of Light and Dark.

guide.context: Adventures are opened from the main menu and their challenges are listed on the Progress screen.

steps.text: Open the adventure from the main menu and finish every objective it lists.

achievements.summary: Cast the spell "forbiddenbox".

guide.context: The spell is entered in the Secrets menu and unlocks the Room 1665 stage.

steps.text: Open the Secrets menu and enter forbiddenbox.

achievements.summary: Be embraced by the Darkasso.

guide.context: In the Room 1665 stage, reach the bottom and collect the Darkasso relic.

steps.text: Open the Room 1665 stage and clear the rooms to the bottom.
Collect the Darkasso.

achievements.summary: Be embraced by the Darkasso.

steps.text: Reach the bottom of the Room 1665 stage and collect the Darkasso.

achievements.description: Reach a Cooldown bonus of -85% with Space Dude.
achievements.summary: Reach -85% Cooldown bonus as Space Dude.

guide.context: Take the XX - Silent Old Sanctuary Arcana and fully upgrade the Empty Tome while holding no extra weapons.

steps.text: Start a run with Space Dude, pick XX - Silent Old Sanctuary, and take no extra weapons.
Find and fully upgrade the Empty Tome until the Cooldown bonus reaches -85%.

achievements.displayName: EXTRA: X - Hail from the Future
achievements.description: Trigger a Weird Souls Purifier with Santa Ladonna.
achievements.summary: Trigger a Weird Souls Purifier as Santa Ladonna.

guide.context: Fully upgrade Santa Ladonna's starting weapon, fuse it with the Clover passive, then collect a Rosary.

steps.text: Start a run with Santa Ladonna and fully upgrade her starting weapon with the Clover passive.
Collect a Rosary to trigger the Weird Souls Purifier.

achievements.description: Trigger a Starry Heavens with She-Moon Eeta.
achievements.summary: Trigger a Starry Heavens as She-Moon Eeta.

guide.context: Fully upgrade She-Moon Eeta's starting weapon, fuse it with the Wings passive, then collect an Orologion.

steps.text: Start a run with She-Moon Eeta and fully upgrade her starting weapon with the Wings passive.
Collect an Orologion to trigger the Starry Heavens.

achievements.displayName: EXTRA: XXI - Wandering the Jet Black
achievements.description: Reach 665 Max Health with Bat Robbert.
achievements.summary: Reach 665 maximum health as Bat Robbert.

guide.context: The Hollow Heart passive, the IV - Awake Arcana, and the Metaglio Left item all raise maximum health.

steps.text: Start a run with Bat Robbert and collect Hollow Heart, IV - Awake, and Metaglio Left.
Keep upgrading them until maximum health reaches 665.

achievements.summary: Find 500 Floor Chickens in total.

guide.context: Unlocks The Coop stage, and collections from earlier runs count.

steps.text: Collect Floor Chickens across your runs until the lifetime total reaches 500.

achievements.description: Find a Parm Aegis in The Coop.
achievements.summary: Collect a Parm Aegis from The Coop.

guide.context: The Mad Groove Arcana speeds up the search.

steps.text: Enter The Coop and collect the Parm Aegis.

achievements.description: Find the Roast chicken with a clock in the middle at the end of The Coop.
achievements.summary: Find the clock-faced roast chicken at the end of The Coop.

steps.text: Survive to the end of The Coop and collect the clock-faced roast chicken.

achievements.summary: Defeat 0 enemies in The Coop.

guide.context: Start the stage and kill nothing for 1 minute to trigger a cutscene.

steps.text: Enter The Coop and avoid killing any enemy for the first minute.

achievements.summary: Survive 20 minutes in The Coop.

guide.context: Unlocks the Gazebo character.

steps.text: Enter The Coop and stay alive for 20 minutes.

achievements.description: Eat as much as possible with Gazebo.
achievements.summary: Eat as much as possible while playing Gazebo.

guide.context: Gazebo gains stat boosts from overhealing on Floor Chickens; keep eating until the boosts stop.

steps.text: Play The Coop with Gazebo and keep eating Floor Chickens until no more stat boosts appear.

achievements.description: Banish 80 or more weapons in a single run.
achievements.summary: Banish at least 80 weapons during one run.

guide.context: Passive items count, and Seal tokens can be bought and used from the Collection.

steps.text: In one run, use the Banish option at least 80 times on weapons or passives.

achievements.displayName: EXTRA: To End An Ice Age
achievements.description: Complete once the adventure To End An Ice Age.
achievements.summary: Finish To End An Ice Age.

guide.context: Unlocks the Reborn She-Moon Eeta skin.

steps.text: Open the adventure from the main menu and finish every objective it lists.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Gaze of Gaea into the Embrace of Gaea.

guide.context: The Gaze of Gaea evolves with the Parm Aegis passive.

steps.text: In one run, hold the Gaze of Gaea and the Parm Aegis and level both to maximum.
Choose the Embrace of Gaea from the level-up choices.

achievements.summary: Find 23 Little Clovers in total.

guide.context: Unlocks the Westwoods stage, and collections from earlier runs count.

steps.text: Collect Little Clovers across your runs until the lifetime total reaches 23.

achievements.summary: Survive 20 minutes in Westwoods.

guide.context: Unlocks the Chula-Reh character.

steps.text: Enter Westwoods and stay alive for 20 minutes.

achievements.description: Find a Karoma's Mana in Westwoods.
achievements.summary: Find a Karoma's Mana in Westwoods.

steps.text: Explore the Westwoods stage and collect the Karoma's Mana.

achievements.description: Find the Masquerade Relic in Westwoods.
achievements.summary: Find the Masquerade Relic in Westwoods.

guide.context: Unlocks Party Mode.

steps.text: Explore the Westwoods stage and collect the Masquerade Relic.

achievements.summary: Get the Magi-Stone to level 7.

steps.text: Pick up the Magi-Stone and keep choosing its upgrades until it reaches level 7.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Magi-Stone into the Kyra-Stones.

steps.text: Max out the Magi-Stone during a run and choose the Kyra-Stones from the level-up choices.

achievements.displayName: EXTRA: XIII - Call of a Mad Moon
achievements.summary: Reach +999% Luck with Chula-Reh.

steps.text: Start a run with Chula-Reh and raise the Luck bonus until it reaches +999%.

achievements.description: Reach Level 80 in Inverse Dairy Plant.
achievements.summary: Reach level 80 on Inverse Dairy Plant.

guide.context: This unlocks the Mazerella stage.

steps.text: Start a run on Inverse Dairy Plant and collect experience gems until you reach level 80.

achievements.description: Find the Chaos Lazulia in Mazerella.
achievements.summary: Find the Chaos Lazulia in Mazerella.

guide.context: Unlocks Carrozza!.

steps.text: Search Mazerella and collect the Chaos Lazulia.

achievements.description: Find the Wax Fetish in Mazerella.
achievements.summary: Find the Wax Fetish in Mazerella.

guide.context: Unlocks the Preserve PowerUp.

steps.text: Search Mazerella and collect the Wax Fetish.

achievements.description: Defeat a total of 251096 Shooting Enemies.
achievements.summary: Kill a total of 251096 Shooting Enemies.

guide.context: Unlocks the Ammo Appalate weapon.

steps.text: Kill Shooting Enemies across your runs until the lifetime total reaches 251096.

achievements.summary: Evolve the Ammo Appalate into the Zi'Appunta Belpaese.

steps.text: Max out the Ammo Appalate during a run and choose the Zi'Appunta Belpaese from the level-up choices.

achievements.description: Find 10 Treasure Chests from Zi'Appunta's ability in a single run.
achievements.summary: Open 10 Golden Treasure Chests in one run with Zi'Appunta.

steps.text: Start a run with Zi'Appunta and open Golden Treasure Chests until the run total reaches 10.

achievements.description: Survive 30 minutes with no weapons in Inverse Green Acres.
achievements.summary: Survive 30 minutes in Inverse Green Acres without weapons.

steps.text: Start a run in Inverse Green Acres with no weapons equipped and stay alive until the 30-minute timer ends.
